summary: Executed backend + frontend regression against external preview URL, covering route loads, discovery calculations/paywall, auth sessions, companion SSE/memory, Stripe checkout/security, premium member actions, sacral/traditions content, mobile overflow, and production build.
action_items: Move secrets out of committed backend/.env and rotate exposed Stripe/LLM credentials.
Tighten CORS config (avoid allow_credentials=true with wildcard origins).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/.env currently contains live-looking secret keys; this is a security risk even in preview forks.
Backend enables CORS allow_credentials=True with CORS_ORIGINS='*'; this is a risky and browser-inconsistent configuration for credentialed flows.
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md seeded Bearer/cookie sessions: test_session_shane_free_2026 and test_session_shane_premium_2026.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed member messages/bookings and additional mood/journal entries via regression tests and UI actions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested flows passed in this run, including real Stripe checkout redirect and premium companion memory controls. Existing pytest suite now includes auth/payment/member security regressions in test_auth_payment_member.py.
rca of the issue: No blocking functional defect reproduced. One temporary automation issue occurred (Playwright cookie API misuse with both url and path), fixed by setting cookie with url only.
